title: Zero-Memory-Spike Large CSV Stream Transformer with AbortController

breakdown.note: Custom Transform stream processes binary chunks, calling callback() when finished to honor backpressure.
AbortController signal provides cooperative cancellation after timeoutMs.
stream.pipeline cleanly orchestrates the stream lifecycle and destroys all handles on error.

expectedOutput: Stream pipeline completed cleanly with constant RSS memory (~48MB RSS heap for 5GB input file).
